inventory_events_quantity_check.name: inventory_events_quantity_check
inventory_events_quantity_check.value:
CASE
          WHEN event_type IN ('stocktake_verification', 'cost_basis_change') THEN quantity = 0
          ELSE quantity > 0
        END

inventory_events_lot_required_check.name: inventory_events_lot_required_check
inventory_events_lot_required_check.value: event_type NOT IN ('opening_balance', 'purchase_receipt', 'manufacturing_output', 'manual_adjustment_increase', 'stocktake_gain', 'manufacturing_variance_gain', 'manual_adjustment_decrease', 'stocktake_loss', 'sales_consumption', 'manufacturing_ingredient_consumption', 'manufacturing_variance_loss', 'quality_scrap', 'unpick_restock', 'quality_disposition_change') OR lot_id IS NOT NULL

inventory_events_cost_required_check.name: inventory_events_cost_required_check
inventory_events_cost_required_check.value: event_type NOT IN ('opening_balance', 'purchase_receipt', 'manufacturing_output', 'manual_adjustment_increase', 'stocktake_gain', 'manufacturing_variance_gain', 'manual_adjustment_decrease', 'stocktake_loss', 'sales_consumption', 'manufacturing_ingredient_consumption', 'manufacturing_variance_loss', 'quality_scrap', 'unpick_restock', 'quality_disposition_change') OR (unit_cost IS NOT NULL AND extended_cost IS NOT NULL AND extended_cost = ROUND(quantity * unit_cost, 6))

inventory_events_non_stock_cost_blank_ch.name: inventory_events_non_stock_cost_blank_check
inventory_events_non_stock_cost_blank_ch.value: event_type NOT IN ('reservation_increase', 'reservation_release', 'demand_increase', 'demand_release', 'expected_increase', 'expected_release', 'cost_basis_change', 'stocktake_verification') OR (lot_id IS NULL AND unit_cost IS NULL AND extended_cost IS NULL)

inventory_events_disposition_check.name: inventory_events_disposition_check
inventory_events_disposition_check.value:
(disposition IS NULL OR disposition IN ('available', 'blocked', 'rejected'))
          AND (from_disposition IS NULL OR from_disposition IN ('available', 'blocked', 'rejected'))
          AND (to_disposition IS NULL OR to_disposition IN ('available', 'blocked', 'rejected'))

inventory_events_quality_disposition_che.name: inventory_events_quality_disposition_check
inventory_events_quality_disposition_che.value:
CASE
          WHEN event_type = 'quality_disposition_change'
            THEN from_disposition IS NOT NULL
              AND to_disposition IS NOT NULL
              AND from_disposition <> to_disposition
          WHEN event_type = 'quality_scrap'
            THEN from_disposition IS NOT NULL
              AND to_disposition IS NULL
          ELSE true
        END

stock_allocations_source_id_check.name: stock_allocations_source_id_check
stock_allocations_source_id_check.value: ("inventory"."stock_allocations"."source_type" = 'stock_pool' AND "inventory"."stock_allocations"."source_id" IS NULL) OR ("inventory"."stock_allocations"."source_type" <> 'stock_pool' AND "inventory"."stock_allocations"."source_id" IS NOT NULL)

stock_allocations_cancelled_check.name: stock_allocations_cancelled_check
stock_allocations_cancelled_check.value: ("inventory"."stock_allocations"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "inventory"."stock_allocations"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("inventory"."stock_allocations"."status" <> 'cancelled' AND "inventory"."stock_allocations"."cancelled_at" IS NULL)

quality_disposition_events_disposition_c.name: quality_disposition_events_disposition_check
quality_disposition_events_disposition_c.value:
from_disposition IN ('available', 'blocked', 'rejected')
          AND (to_disposition IS NULL OR to_disposition IN ('available', 'blocked', 'rejected'))
